structure.layout: single-column centered download page (1024px container) with floating sticky pill nav, centered hero, framed product demo, divided options list and multi-column footer

aesthetics.typography: Geist for nav, headings, body and links; Geist Mono for letter-spaced uppercase eyebrows (DOWNLOAD, OTHER WAYS TO RUN FLOE, footer column labels), version/date meta line, window title bar and status bar
aesthetics.typeScale: Strong contrast: 60px/600 H1, 18px subtitle and row titles, 14px body/links/nav, 11-12px mono uppercase tracked eyebrows

notes: Near-black monochrome dark theme with Vercel/Geist flavour. Nav is a floating fully-rounded pill with a dark-filled pill marking the current page and an inverted white GitHub pill CTA; it stays fixed on scroll. Primary CTA is the official Microsoft Store badge. Mono uppercase wide-tracked eyebrows (light blue in hero). The product demo is a 14px-radius framed 'window' with mono title bar 'FLOE DESKTOP · 1.1.1' and terminal-like status line 'room open · code quiet-fetch-sled' wrapping an animated demo image (aria description). Secondary download options use a three-column row layout (title / grey description / right-aligned bold links) separated by hairline dividers. Footer: brand blurb + four uppercase-labelled link columns.
